descriptionChirho: Qal stem verb meaning to go, walk, or travel to a destination, encompassing perfective forms (3ms 'he went', 1cp 'we went', 3mp 'they went') and imperative (ms 'go!'). The three clusters represent purely inflectional variation — person, number, and mood — within the same Qal stem and the same core meaning of physical movement. All translations consistently reflect a single motion verb: eng 'went/go', spa 'fue/fuimos/ve', arb 'ذَهَبَ/ذَهَبْنا/اِذْهَبْ', hin 'गया/गए/जाओ', kor '갔더라/갔다/가라', swa 'akaenda/walikwenda/nenda'.
